record_title: Exact stationary moment parabola and critical rigidity in the Rössler system
provenance: Analytic invariant-measure, conditional-flux, moment-balance, and equality-rigidity arguments for the classical Rössler flow.
limitations: Requires a,b,c>0 and compact support for invariant-measure statements. The theorem does not classify noncompact invariant objects, prove attractor existence, or imply pointwise convergence at the critical threshold. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; later model-specific literature not inspected theorem by theorem leaves residual priority risk.
